intro: Designed for rest, built for life. Our Doze bed brings cushioned comfort, modular storage, and thoughtful details together in a refined walnut finish that suits every space.

features.title: Comfortable cushioned headboard
features.text: Upholstered in soft synthetic leather, the headboard offers plush back support—ideal for relaxing, reading, or unwinding at the end of the day.

features.title: Storage built into headboard
features.text: Drop-down headboard panels reveal hidden compartments—perfect for tucking away chargers, books, or bedtime essentials while keeping surfaces clean.

features.title: Smart display ledge
features.text: The broad top ledge provides space for your phone, photos, or décor—always within reach, with no extra furniture needed.

features.title: Box + pull-out storage combo
features.text: Enjoy the best of both worlds with easy-access pull-out drawers and deep under-bed box storage to keep your space clutter-free.

features.title: Engineered for durability
features.text: Made from high-grade engineered wood, this bed is strong, stable, and designed to stand up to everyday use without compromising style.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
